results.title: Tampa finishes West Coast trip with 9-0 record
results.description: WEST SACRAMENTO, Calif. -- The American League-best Tampa Bay Rays became the second East Coast team in major league history to go 9-0 on a West Coast trip, beating the Athletics 8-4 on Wednesday behind a three-run home run from Liam Hicks (Arkansas State) and another solid start by Drew Rasmussen.

results.title: 'I played for Newcastle in the Premier League – here's what Eddie Howe was really like'
results.description: Matt Targett has signed for Hull City after leaving Newcastle United this summer and the left-back has opened up on his difficult time at St James' Park and his backing of Eddie Howe
